نختطف (form VIII)
# نَخْتَطِفُ (naḵtaṭifu) /nax.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# نُخْتَطَفُ (nuḵtaṭafu) /nux.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# نَخْتَطِفَ (naḵtaṭifa) /nax.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# نُخْتَطَفَ (nuḵtaṭafa) /nux.ta.tˤa.f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
